---
title: Create a template
description: Save a live environment as a reusable stack.
---

You can save a live environment as a template from the canvas when you want to reuse a stack (services, databases, and the variables the template should prompt for).

Publishing to the public [catalog](https://stackblaze.com/templates) is a separate review path — contact support if you want a template listed.

For git-reviewed topology, prefer [config as code](/blueprint/) (`stackblaze.yaml`) over a dashboard template.

See [Templates](/templates/).
